name: app-yellow-research-tag-card-tilted-on-white
title: Tilted Yellow Research Card
whatItIs: A mostly white wide frame with a tilted rounded yellow card at the left listing Research activities such as data analysis, user interviews, problem statement, persona and journey in white text.
whatItMeans: A single coloured card on white is an eye-catching label, and the tilt adds motion, as if mid-animation.
techniques: Tilted coloured card as a title element
Small white text in scattered columns on the card
Large blank space to allow an animation or content to arrive

vocabulary.definition: A card rotated slightly for energy.
A card naming one phase of a process.
